origin.mms_origins.floran.name: Floran
origin.mms_origins.floran.description: Children of the green, the Florans drink the sun and wear the forest as armor. They bloom under open sky and slip through soil and leaf unseen, yet fire, frost and the taste of flesh are the price of their growth.
origin.mms_origins.fairy.name: Fairy
origin.mms_origins.fairy.description: Tiny winged folk of the glades, light enough to ride the wind and sharp-eyed enough to find what others miss. Villagers adore them and monsters covet them, and their delicate bodies fear every blow.
layer.mms_origins.fairy_wings.name: Wings
mms_origins.gui.choose_wings.title: Choose your Wings
mms_origins.gui.view_wings.title: Your Wings
origin.mms_origins.monarch_butterfly.des: Broad, pointed wings in fiery orange and black.
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.name: Azure Wings
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.descri: Soft, rounded wings in shimmering blue.
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.name: Cirno's Wings
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.descripti: Crystalline ice-fairy wings of frozen shards.
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.name: Fairy Wings
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.descripti: Iridescent gossamer wings that catch the light.
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.name: Slime Wings
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.descripti: Squishy translucent wings of jellied ooze.
origin.mms_origins.truffle.name: Truffle
origin.mms_origins.truffle.description: Fungal folk who fruit in the dark where things have died. Poison and hunger pass them by, but their bodies are frail and their appetite is for rot. They loose spores to run light-footed, to sicken what they strike, or to cloud a field in a haze that turns beasts to their side.
origin.mms_origins.piglin.name: Piglin
origin.mms_origins.piglin.description: Born of the bastion and the crimson waste, piglins carry gold as a birthright and barter among their own kind. The Nether's heat cannot trouble them, but the overworld sky slowly turns their minds, and villagers want nothing to do with them.
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.description: Your hide has hardened into living bark.
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.descrip: Sunlight feeds you as surely as bread.
badge.mms_origins.photosynthesis.0: Hunger drains 50% slower while exposed to the sun.
power.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.name: Sun-Basked
power.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.descri: Warmth is the weather you were grown for.
badge.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.0: Take 70% less heat damage and resist heat buildup. You never overheat past half the scale.
power.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.name: Cold-Blighted
badge.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.0: Take double damage from freezing, and chill much faster.
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.name: Quick Metabolism
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.descr: Fast-growing things are quick to hunger.
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.name: Verdant Diet
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.descripti: Flesh sits wrong in a mouth made for leaves.
power.mms_origins.diminutive.name: Diminutive
power.mms_origins.diminutive.description: You are small enough to rest in a hand, and the world lies a little farther away.
badge.mms_origins.diminutive.0: You stand at 40% of normal size.
power.mms_origins.light_step.name: Light Step
power.mms_origins.light_step.description: You weigh so little that the world never hears you coming.
badge.mms_origins.light_step.0: Your steps make no vibrations, so sculk sensors and wardens cannot hear them.
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.descript: A delicate frame, built for flight and not for fighting.
badge.mms_origins.fragile_frame.0: Take 50% more damage from every source, and deal 50% less.
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.descript: Tiny claws find purchase on any wall.
badge.mms_origins.wall_scramble.0: [Primary] toggles wall climbing. While it is on, press against a wall to climb it.
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.name: Keen Forager
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.descripti: Small eyes miss nothing underfoot, and fortune seems to follow you through every field, foe and chest.
badge.mms_origins.keen_forager.1: +18 Luck for chest loot, and fishing draws from a richer loot table.
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.name: Anxious Heart
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.descript: A heavy blow sends your heart racing, dropping you from the air until you calm.
badge.mms_origins.anxious_heart.0: A single hit that costs you 4 hearts or more cancels flight for 10 s.
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.name: Fairy Charm
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.descriptio: Villagers are enamored by your mystique and beauty, and lower their prices for you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_charm.0: Villager trades cost 25% less of their base price, at least 1 item off each.
power.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.name: Fairy's Blessing
power.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.descrip: Life quickens in a fairy's company, and those who tend growing things are glad of you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_blessing.0: Other players within 12 blocks of you are blessed: Floran plants grow faster, Avian hoe harvests yield more crops and gold, and Truffles grazing shroomlight gain extra saturation. Blessings from several fairies stack, reaching full strength with 3.
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.name: Wayfarer's Eye
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.descr: Long roads teach you where the good things hide.
badge.mms_origins.wayfarer_forager.0: While you also hold the Explorer job: Fortune +1, Looting +1 and +8 Luck for chest loot.
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.name: Worldly Charm
power.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.descrip: Villagers warm to a traveller with stories to tell, and lower their prices for you.
badge.mms_origins.wayfarer_charm.0: While you also hold the Explorer job: villager trades cost 10% less of their base price, at least 1 item off each.
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.name: Fairy Allure
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.descripti: The same mystique that charms villagers draws monsters to you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_allure.0: Idle hostile mobs that can see you sometimes single you out over other prey.
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.name: Fairy Flight
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.descripti: While your belly is full, take wing and fly freely. Hunger drags you back to the earth.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.0: Double-tap jump to fly. Needs at least 3 drumsticks of hunger, and flying slowly drains it.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.1: Below 3 hearts of health you fly at half speed. Below 3 drumsticks of hunger you lose flight and fall.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.2: Sprint while flying to double your speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and your wings build smoothly to 4x over the next 2 s.
power.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.name: Enchanted Groves
power.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.descri: In the enchanted groves where old magic runs deep, the same woods where Florans work their reclamations, you strike harder, fortune favors you, and your wings carry you faster.
badge.mms_origins.skyris_homeland.0: In a dark forest, the Skyris Vale or one of its sister groves (Weeping Witch Forest, Enchanted Tangle, Ebony Woods, Forgotten Forest, Jacaranda Jungle): +2 attack damage, +3 Luck and 50% faster flight.
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.name: Spore Shift
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.descriptio: Acrid spores always cling to you, and a drifting cloud can be drawn or stowed at will, each drawing on a reserve that mends itself in rest.
badge.mms_origins.spore_shift.0: Press [Secondary] while standing to stow or draw your Drifting spores. Acrid spores are always with you.
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.name: Acrid Spores
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.descript: Bitter spores cling to every strike you land.
badge.mms_origins.combat_spores.1: A hit also doses the target with caustic spores: 1 damage per second for 3 s, never lethal. The same target cannot be dosed again for 12 s.
badge.mms_origins.combat_spores.2: Each dose costs a third of the reserve and some hunger. The reserve refills in 1.5 s after a 3 s pause.
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.name: Drifting Spores
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.descripti: A haze of spores lifts your feet and quickens your hands.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.0: While drawn: Speed II and 40% faster attacks while the reserve lasts.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.1: Sprinting drains the reserve 5 per second and each hit costs 10, out of 60. It refills in 2 s after a 2 s pause.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.2: Crouch and hold [Primary] to sense living things within 24 blocks through walls. Drains the reserve 5 per second.
power.mms_origins.spore_haze.name: Mind Haze
power.mms_origins.spore_haze.description: A green fog of spores that mends you and bends the wills of the beasts caught in it.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.0: Press [Primary] while standing to loose a spore haze of 5 blocks radius that lingers 9 s. Cooldown 45 s.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.1: Inside the haze you gain Regeneration II. Every other mob in it gets Weakness and Slowness II.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.2: Any mob it touches becomes your loyal soldier for 30 s: it follows you, fights what you fight or what hurts you, and spares you and your other soldiers. The Ender Dragon, the Wither and Grovekeepers are immune to the mind effect.
badge.mms_origins.spore_haze.3: Afterwards the mob returns to its own ways but never turns on you again, unless you strike it first.
power.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.de: Poison and hunger mean nothing to a fungus, but a fruiting body is fragile.
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.name: Saprophyte
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.descri: Only what has rotted will feed you. Clean food turns to ash on your tongue.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.0: You can only eat rotten flesh, spider eyes, poisonous potatoes and raw meat or fish.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.1: Rotten flesh grants a short burst of Saturation, and its Hunger cannot touch you.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.2: Crouch and hold [Secondary] while looking at stone or deepslate within 5 blocks for 1 s to grow it into shroomlight, every 3 s for a little hunger. Letting go early cancels it. Use any shroomlight to graze on it for 1 hunger and a lot of saturation, and fairies within 12 blocks may add more, likelier the more fairies are near (sure with 3).
power.mms_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.mms_origins.nether_born.descriptio: The fires of the Nether raised you. Its heat is home, and the Overworld feels cold and harsh.
badge.mms_origins.nether_born.0: You spawn in the Nether, and return there when you die without a bed.
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.name: Fire Resilience
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.descri: Flame and lava are the air you grew up in, and they do little to trouble your hide.
badge.mms_origins.fire_resilience.0: Take 50% less fire and lava damage.
power.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.d: The Nether's furnace air is your birthright. Heat can never lay you low, no matter the world you walk.
badge.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.0: Immune to heat stroke. Take 70% less heat damage and resist heat buildup. You never overheat past half the scale.
power.mms_origins.nether_chill.name: Nether-Blooded
power.mms_origins.nether_chill.descripti: Raised in the Nether's furnace, you feel the Overworld's cold more keenly.
badge.mms_origins.nether_chill.0: Take 25% more freezing damage, and chill a little faster.
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.name: Nether Forager
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.descript: Your kind learned to live on what the crimson waste provides.
badge.mms_origins.nether_forage.0: You can eat crimson and warped fungi, mushrooms and bone meal (2 hunger each).
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.name: Glowcap Feast
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.desc: A shroomlight is a rare treat, and its inner fire lingers in you after it is eaten.
badge.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.0: You can eat shroomlights (3 hunger), which leave you glowing for 10 s.
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.name: Sun Shy
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.description: The open sky of the overworld is a strange and tiring place, and standing beneath it wears you down.
badge.mms_origins.sun_shy.0: Hunger drains 50% faster while exposed to the sun.
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.name: Gilded
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.descrip: Gold is your birthright, and you fight hardest when you wear it.
badge.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.1: Deal 1.2x damage, plus 0.2x for each piece of golden armor worn (2x with a full set).
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.name: Bastion Kin
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.description: Piglins and brutes count you as one of their own, and they will trade and fight for you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.0: Piglins and brutes will not target you. If you strike one, only that piglin holds a grudge, until it hits you back.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.1: Piglins within 16 blocks rally against anything that attacks you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.2: Piglins barter from a richer loot table for you, and a gold block buys three different goods.
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.name: Arms Dealing
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.descripti: The brutes guard the bastion armories. Offer gold and a brute may hand over war gear, or simply pocket your payment.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.0: Drop a gold ingot or block within 12 blocks of a piglin brute. It admires the gold for 6 s, then may barter bastion gear.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.1: An ingot pays out half the time, a block 55% of the time. Otherwise the brute keeps the gold.
power.mms_origins.zombification.name: Zombification
power.mms_origins.zombification.descript: The Overworld air slowly turns you, and a turned piglin has no kin.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.0: Each second in the Overworld fills a 10-minute meter. The Nether drains it, 1 per 2 s, until you turn.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.1: Turned, you can only eat raw meat, fish, rotten flesh or golden food. Piglins flee from you unless you draw a weapon on them.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.2: Cured by eating golden food (even on a full stomach), or by dying.
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.name: Quarantine Exile
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.descr: A turned piglin is no one's kin, and while the sickness holds you, your own people want nothing to do with you.
badge.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.0: While turned you suffer constant Weakness and Hunger, and no piglin or brute within 128 blocks of you will barter.
power.mms_origins.beastly.name: Beastly
power.mms_origins.beastly.description: Villagers see a monster from the Nether, not a customer.
badge.mms_origins.beastly.0: Villagers refuse to trade with you unless you wear a carved pumpkin.
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.name: Otherworlder
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.descr: You are a stranger to the surface. Its folk cannot follow your speech, and its fields were never sown for a body like yours.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.0: Villager trades cost 25% more of their base price, at least 1 item more each.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.1: Crops and baked goods restore 60% less hunger and saturation.
power.mms_origins.beast_tongue.name: Beast Tongue
power.mms_origins.beast_tongue.descripti: Your growling speech unsettles a villager, who takes you for something half-wild and charges you dearly for it.
badge.mms_origins.beast_tongue.0: Villager trades cost 25% more of their base price, at least 1 item more each.
power.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.name: Carnivore Diet
power.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.descrip: Your gut turns on anything green. Only flesh feeds you, and you would sooner take it raw and dripping than cooked.
badge.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.0: You can only eat meat and fish.
badge.mms_origins.carnivore_diet.1: Eating raw meat grants a brief burst of Saturation.
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.name: Guardian Kinship
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.descr: Guardians and elder guardians know you for kin and leave you in peace, unless you strike first.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.0: Guardians and elder guardians ignore you unless you attack them.
power.mms_origins.guardian_beam.name: Guardian Beam
power.mms_origins.guardian_beam.descript: As the guardians of the deep do, you focus the sea into a searing beam.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_beam.0: Hold [Primary] to lock onto a creature in view within 16 blocks. Keep it in sight for 1.5 s to strike it for 3 hearts, ignoring armor and Protection.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_beam.1: Needs a full Tide Magic bar and 47% moisture, and spends both. Full moisture covers two strikes, but not if you dash in between.
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.name: Fish Anatomy
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.descripti: Gills, fins and deep-water eyes: a body built for the sea, and as cold as its depths.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.0: Immune to freezing damage, and the cold never takes hold of you.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.3: Tap [Secondary] to dash: a strong surge in water, or a fixed 6 block dash (+1 per Depth Strider level) on land at 35% moisture or more. Costs half your Tide Magic and 10% moisture. You cannot jump for 0.5 s after.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.4: Hold [Secondary] for half a second to toggle clear underwater vision.
power.mms_origins.tide_magic.name: Tide Magic
power.mms_origins.tide_magic.description: You channel the sea through the water you carry, in dash and beam and tide.
badge.mms_origins.tide_magic.0: Dash needs and spends 30% of your magic bar. Riptide on land needs your magic bar at half or more and spends half of it. Guardian Beam needs and spends the full bar.
badge.mms_origins.tide_magic.1: The bar refills fully in 10 s.
power.mms_origins.like_water.name: Like Water
power.mms_origins.like_water.description: The sea is yours to move through as freely as others walk on land.
badge.mms_origins.like_water.0: No underwater mining penalty, even while floating off the ground.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.name: Seaborn
power.mms_origins.seaborn.description: Born to the sea, you can find no rest on dry land.
badge.mms_origins.seaborn.1: You can only sleep or set your spawn while standing in water.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.cant_sleep: You cannot rest out of the water.
power.mms_origins.water_power.name: Water Power
power.mms_origins.water_power.descriptio: The tide answers your blows, and wet, you strike far harder.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.0: Deal +2 damage while in water or rain, or at 35% moisture or more.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.1: Deal 2 less damage in the Nether and in hot biomes, with no bonus there.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.2: Your trident deals 1.5x damage when you and your target are both in water, thrown or in melee.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.3.prefix: You are able to craft tridents.
power.mms_origins.wetness.name: Wetness
power.mms_origins.wetness.description: The moisture beneath your skin: the sea you carry, which you breathe by and channel your magic through.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.0: Water, rain and cauldrons refill it in about 10 s. A potion or water skin adds 10%.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.1: It drains 1 point a second out of water (twice as fast in the Nether), 10 minutes from full. You breathe on land while any remains.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.2: Conduit Power on land refills it to full and holds it there.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.3: If you catch fire, 5% of your moisture puts the flames out at once.
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.descript: Roots drink deep, and the creatures of the sea wilt before them. Flame wilts the green in turn.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to fishmen and aquatic mobs.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.1: Deal a further 50% more to a fishman who is wet (in water, in rain, or at 35% moisture or more).
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.2: Deal 50% less damage to blazeborn, blazes, magma cubes, ghasts and striders.
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.descript: Water smothers flame. You fall hard on blazeborn and fiery creatures, but the green drinks you in.
badge.mms_origins.water_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to blazeborn, blazes, magma cubes, ghasts and striders.
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.descripti: Fire withers the green and hisses against the sea, which washes over you all the harder.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to florans, and a further 50% while you are on fire.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.1: Deal 50% less damage to fishmen and aquatic mobs.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.2: Take 50% more damage from guardians, pufferfish and dolphins.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.name: Sunlit Vigor
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.descripti: Under open sky your sap runs hot, and your blows land harder.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.0: Deal 25% more damage while exposed to the sun. Sunlit Fury replaces this while it is active.
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.name: In Tune With Nature
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.descrip: Life quickens around you, and the green things you pass lean toward the light.
badge.mms_origins.verdant_growth.0: Plants within about 2 chunks of you grow roughly 30% faster, rising by 10% for each fairy within 12 blocks, up to 60% with 3.
power.mms_origins.sun_power.name: Sun Power
power.mms_origins.sun_power.description: You store sunlight as a quiet inner glow, to be spent when the need is great.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.0: A reserve of 7 sections, spent on Sunlit Fury, Grovekeepers and Nature's Reclamation.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.1: Refills only under open sky, faster as the sun nears noon. Around high noon this peaks as Mael's Blessing, which empowers your other sun powers.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.2: Drinking a potion or water skin gives 1 section, filling you up to half the reserve, so you can raise a Grovekeeper even at night.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.name: Sunlit Fury
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.descriptio: Burn the light you carry and fight like a thing possessed, until the glow gutters out.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.0: [Primary] toggles. While active you deal +3 melee damage and burn Sun Power.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.1: A full reserve lasts about 28 s alone, 14 s with one Grovekeeper and 9 s with two or more. It switches off when Sun Power runs out.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.2: Under Mael's Blessing: another +3 damage, 25% less damage taken and 20% more speed.
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.name: Grovekeepers
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.descri: Coax a creaking Grovekeeper out of the earth, a patient guardian that stands between you and harm.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.0: Hold [Secondary] (not sneaking) for 1.5 s to raise a Grovekeeper. Costs 3 sections of Sun Power; letting go early costs nothing.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.1: Up to 2 at once, or 4 under Mael's Blessing. Each lasts 2 minutes, then crumbles and refunds its cost.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.2: They slow what they hit for 5 s, draw nearby hostiles off you, and freeze while their target is looking at them.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.3: A slain Grovekeeper refunds its cost after 30 s. One more than 32 blocks from you withers away and refunds at once.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.4: Raised under Mael's Blessing, they have 50% more health and damage, and run up to 30% faster at noon.
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.name: Nature's Reclamation
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.descrip: Ask the growing world to take back what hands have made. Your body keeps a biological clock that tells you when the sun, and your strength, will peak.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.0: While the sun is up, hold a crafted item in your off hand and hold [Primary] for 5 s to unmake the whole stack into its ingredients. Sneak with an empty off hand to unmake your main-hand item instead, such as a two-handed weapon. You are rooted in place while you channel.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.1: Each reclamation costs Sun Power and strains your sun metabolism, slowing how fast you gather sunlight. Both costs shrink toward noon: about 1 reclamation at dawn, 10 at noon. Strain fades over time.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.2: Enchantments move onto books, one per book in your inventory. Any beyond your books are lost.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.no_su: You lack the sun power to reclaim this.
power.mms_origins.leaf_form.name: Leaf Form
power.mms_origins.leaf_form.description: Fold yourself into a drift of leaves, and slip through soil and bough like a breath of wind.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.0: Sneak and press [Secondary] to fold into leaf form over half a second, slowed while you change. Repeat to return, which needs you within a block of the surface.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.1: In leaf form you pass through and sink into dirt, leaves, logs, roots, mushroom blocks and moss, and climb them along with sand, gravel and clay. Stone stops you. You cannot jump.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.2: In leaf form you cannot sprint, use items, or interact with blocks and creatures. You drift at a steady pace, a little slower than a running player above ground and twice as fast as one buried in natural blocks. Buried, you hover, rising with [Jump] and sinking with [Sneak], and you never take fall damage.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.3: Sunlight heals you half a heart every 2.5 s.
badge.mms_origins.leaf_form.5: Buried, your breath drains quickly. With none left you take 2 drowning damage every second.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_e: You need a full crafted item to reclaim.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.succe: The item unravels into its parts. You could bear %s more at this hour.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.3: Your biological clock chimes shortly before noon, when your strength peaks.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.4: In the enchanted groves the fairies call home (dark forests, the Skyris Vale and their sister groves), reclamation strains you half as much and sunlight fills you 50% faster.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_d: This magic needs the sun in the sky.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.strai: Your sap is too strained to reclaim more. Rest, or wait for the sun to climb.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.noon_: Your biological clock stirs: the sun nears its peak, and so do you.
